notes.title: London Games Festival
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that Point of Mew has been selected for Now Play This, our favourite experimental games festival! 

Come along to the exhibition at Somerset House and check out a wonderful collection of games that push the boundaries of game design on this year's theme of [i]Love[/i], as well as many other exciting events at the London Games Festival.

[url=https://nowplaythis.net/2023-festival/]Festival information and tickets
[/url]
